subject.title: 飞书话题群(Topic Group)被识别为p2p导致消息路由错误

question: What Feishu/Lark signal should OpenClaw trust to classify `chat_type: "p2p"` events in `oc_...` conversations as group/topic traffic instead of direct traffic?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but current tests show root/thread metadata and `oc_` prefixes are not safe as unconditional classifiers; the permanent behavior needs maintainer/API-contract validation before automation should patch it.

options.title: Validate and share a narrow discriminator
options.body: Confirm the Feishu topic/OpenChat signal, then land one helper used by dispatch and mention-forward paths with true-p2p regression tests.

options.title: Adopt an existing candidate PR after narrowing
options.body: Use the open closing/candidate work only after replacing broad prefix or root/thread assumptions with the maintainer-approved discriminator.

options.title: Keep current direct behavior for ambiguous p2p events
options.body: Avoid new routing risk for ambiguous Feishu events, but leave topic-group users with the reported broken workflow until stronger evidence appears.

recommendation.title: Validate and share a narrow discriminator
recommendation.body: Confirm the Feishu topic/OpenChat signal, then land one helper used by dispatch and mention-forward paths with true-p2p regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current classifier blame and recent Feishu topic/session history point to this owner as the best available decision router.
